literal: bersara is the Malaysian word (ms.wikipedia.org/PRPM), distinct from Indonesian pensiun
jururawat has its own ms.wikipedia.org article; distinct from Indonesian perawat
jurutera = juru- (skilled handler) + jentera (machinery); its own ms.wikipedia.org article; distinct from Indonesian insinyur
pejabat is the Malaysian word for office, distinct from Indonesian kantor
saudara (age-neutral sibling) + lelaki, matching this pack's own anak lelaki/anak perempuan pattern rather than the age-graded abang/adik
pasangan is the ordinary word for a romantic/life partner, not a business partner (rakan kongsi)
rakan is the Malaysian spelling, distinct from Indonesian rekan
